title: The Reason for the Extra Plate
youtube_title: The Reason for the Extra Plate | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Esme about reason an extra plate is always in the stack. Esme wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
